xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4260: Harness effort correctness: per-harness mapping tests, clamping in adapters, harnesses.mdx rows, and a CLIProxy --effort spike

plan.title: Harness effort correctness: per-harness mapping tests, clamping in adapters, harnesses.mdx rows, and a CLIProxy --effort spike
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 27 files across 5 subsystems (src/lib plus four individual doc/script files). Each adapter fallback removal must land with its producers and with the test fixtures that build that launch, otherwise the launch either throws (D2) or silently changes effort; 14 of the 27 files are one-to-three-line edits or test fixtures. Splitting by harness would put the shared launcher-generator.ts, launcher-generator.test.ts and model-capabilities.ts edits into several issues that must serialize anyway.

narratives.Problem: After PAN-4249, effort resolves through resolveEffort, but seven harness adapters still invent their own default (`?? 'high'` in runtimes/codex.ts, acp/host.ts, codex/app-server-host.ts, launcher-generator.ts x2, launcher-codex-command.ts, and the `effort = 'high'` default in kimi-effort.ts) and two copy the level list. Planning also found four live bugs: codex work-TUI agents write the raw (unresolved) effort into config.toml so role/sub-role effort is lost (F2); OhmypiRuntime.spawnAgent drops the resolved effort crash-respawn and session-rotation pass (F3); clamping kimi-code/k3 against its native-level row turns medium into low and xhigh into high before translation (F4); gpt-5.5 has no effort list so max reaches Codex although Codex does not advertise it (F5). No harness has a test that proves the native value for all five levels, and the harness docs do not state each mechanism or whether CLIProxy-routed GPT honors --effort.
narratives.Proposal: Producers resolve, emitters never default (PRD D1/D2/D3). Every producer that builds a launch config or host argv calls resolveEffort({ explicit, model, harness[, role] }) (OpenCode variants pass through, D4). Emitters drop every fallback and level-list copy; where a harness always received a value, a missing one throws a named `... requires <field>` error. Fix the kimi-code/k3 rows to list canonical levels (translation narrows, D5) and give gpt-5.5 low..xhigh (D6). Keep the pi and muse harness rows at low..xhigh (D7). Add one five-level mapping table per harness in the existing test files (D10). The CLIProxy spike was answered during planning: Claude Code sends output_config.effort with adaptive thinking, and CLIProxy v7.3.16 maps it to Codex reasoning.effort, so --effort is honored and no follow-up issue is needed (F7, D11). Document each harness's mechanism and mapping in configuration/harnesses.mdx, align harness-landscape.mdx and effort.mdx, and drop the five adapter rows from scripts/lint-effort.sh.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the ohmypi or muse HarnessBehavior.effortLevels rows (stay low..xhigh).
- No edit to packages/pi-extension or packages/ohmypi-extension, and no other OMP-specific work (PAN-4003).
- No handling of Codex-native non-canonical values (for example `ultra`) synced back from the TUI via thread/settings/updated.
- No prime-agent mapping test or code change (documented only).
- No CLIProxy code change and no CLIProxy follow-up issue.
- No change to role launch surfaces, tier slots, planning effort semantics, or effort display (PAN-4256, PAN-4257, PAN-4258, PAN-4259); spawn.ts, spawn-prep.ts and spawn-planning-session.ts get exactly one museEffort line plus one import each.
- No xhigh or max default anywhere, and no `?? DEFAULT_EFFORT` or default-parameter substitute for a removed fallback.
- No emitter (launcher-generator.ts, launcher-codex-command.ts, acp/host.ts, codex/app-server-host.ts, kimi-effort.ts) imports resolve-effort.ts.
- No new model rows; only the gpt-5.5, kimi-code/k3 and kimi-code/k3-256k effortLevels values change.
- No CLIProxy request logging enabled on the shared sidecar.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve in producers; emitters never default. Where a harness always received an effort, a missing value throws `<harness> launcher requires <field>`.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'values resolved upstream'. Omitting the flag instead would silently hand the choice to each harness's own default (Kimi's and Codex's are not high), breaking PAN-4249 NFR-1 and the no-hardcoded-fallback principle; throwing matches the existing '... launcher requires X' errors in launcher-generator.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix kimi-code/k3 and kimi-code/k3-256k effortLevels to all five canonical levels.
autoDecisions.rationale: With upstream clamping, the native-level row turns medium into low and xhigh into high before kimi-effort.ts translates (verified against clampEffort). PAN-4249 D6 says translation stays in adapters; the k3/k3[1m] ACP rows already list all five.

Codex 0.159's own model catalog (~/.codex/models_cache.json supported_reasoning_levels) advertises gpt-5.5 without max; Codex's protocol treats effort as a per-model string, so the model row is where the restriction belongs.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the ohmypi and muse harness rows at low..xhigh although omp 17.4.1, pi 0.85.0 and muse 1.4.2 parse max.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance criterion asks for max clamping on pi and muse; CLI parsing does not prove the routed models honor max; PAN-4249 D8 set these rows. Relaxing them is a separate operator decision, recorded as a non-goal.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not edit the pi/ohmypi extension ThinkingLevel unions; re-label their lint rows as native-vocabulary matches.
autoDecisions.rationale: They model the Pi runtime's own API (off/minimal), not EFFORT_LEVELS; the operator is removing OMP support (PAN-4003) and asked that no time go into OMP-specific code.

autoDecisions.summary: Close the CLIProxy spike during planning with no follow-up issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: A local capture showed Claude Code sends output_config.effort with adaptive thinking for gpt-5.6-luna; CLIProxyAPI v7.3.16 (the installed 7.3.16/c404af96) maps it to Codex reasoning.effort in internal/translator/codex/claude/codex_claude_request.go. The question is answered without live model calls.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the mapping tables in existing test files rather than one new mapping-test file.
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing files already hold the fixtures (fake codex home, fake app-server manager, ACP stub runtime) and many must change anyway for the required-effort fixtures; this keeps the file surface smaller.

narrative.Action: PRD W1. In src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts: (1) getCodexLauncherFields computes `const codexEffort = resolveEffort({ explicit: effort, role, model, harness: 'codex' }).effort;` once and passes it to initCodexHome as `effort: codexEffort` and returns it as `codexEffort` (fixes F2: work-TUI config.toml used the raw effort). (2) getAcpLauncherFields renames `_role` to `role`, computes the harness once, and always returns `acpEffort: harness === 'opencode' && effort && !isEffortLevel(effort) ? effort : resolveEffort({ explicit: effort, role, model, harness }).effort` (return field becomes required `acpEffort: string`). (3) getKimiCodeLauncherFields always returns `kimiCodeEffort: resolveEffort({ explicit: effort, model: kimiCodeModel, harness: 'kimi-code' }).effort` (required field). Tests in runtime-command-effort.test.ts per PRD W1 step 4: codex hoist with roles.review.effort low and an initCodexHome spy; claude-code table over EFFORT_LEVELS on claude-fable-5 and the claude-sonnet-4-6 xhigh->high row via getRoleRuntimeBaseCommand(model, name, 'review', 'claude-code', undefined, level); kimi-code default high; OpenCode variant pass-through; ACP k3 default high. Mock initCodexHome and loadYamlConfig so no real ~/.overdeck path is written.
